pocket_rule: CONTACT CAN ROTATE THE TOOL INTO A NEW RECOVERY PROBLEM. THE FEET MUST BUY A LEGAL RETURN CORRIDOR BEFORE THE HOOK CAN COME HOME.

source.identity: Grim Reaper — Sword Master — NES — Enemies & Bosses

observed: complete 258x344 static source raster inspected as evidence
long tool channel changes envelope while much lower-body/support mass remains comparatively stable

keys.name: ASYMMETRIC_READY
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root stacked behind split base with left hip loaded
keys.tool_arc_note: hooked tool floats forward with butt retained behind rear hip
keys.clearance_note: rear and front return volumes both open

keys.name: COIL_WITH_RETURN_RESERVE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis drops rearward and away before shaft commits
keys.tool_arc_note: hands compress; tool butt travels back farther than head
keys.clearance_note: rear corridor deliberately reserved for later recovery

keys.name: ROOT_COMMIT_BRIDGE
keys.support_contact: rear drive feeds arriving front brace
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis advances first while front support catches the new base
keys.tool_arc_note: shaft lengthens through hands but head remains short of deflector
keys.clearance_note: old rear reserve is partially spent by commitment

keys.name: PRECONTACT_REACH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root is already forward before contact
keys.tool_arc_note: tool head approaches synthetic deflector; shaft still mostly axial
keys.clearance_note: contact has not occurred; return corridor remains provisional

keys.name: DEFLECTION_CONTACT
keys.support_contact: front braces while rear drive still arrives
keys.motion_arc_root_note: contact occurs before maximum body travel
keys.tool_arc_note: hook meets synthetic diagonal deflector at x56/y11
keys.clearance_note: contact creates a rotational constraint, not an endpoint stop

keys.name: PINNED_ROTATION_ROOT_OVERRUN
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis overruns forward/down while front leg compresses
keys.tool_arc_note: tool head slides up-left along deflector and shaft rotates counterclockwise around the hands
keys.clearance_note: old axial return lane is now wrong because the hook has been externally rotated

keys.name: RELEASE_WRONG_SIDE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root reaches its deepest forward overrun after contact releases
keys.tool_arc_note: shaft continues across upper body for one beat; distal head remains high and rearward of outgoing line
keys.clearance_note: immediate reverse rotation would sweep hook through forbidden body/deflector volume

keys.name: CORRIDOR_STEP_LAUNCH
keys.support_contact: front support alone catches root while rear foot leaves
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis yields back/left instead of snapping to ready
keys.tool_arc_note: hands freeze tool orientation while base moves underneath it
keys.clearance_note: rear foot launches to buy physical space before tool withdrawal

keys.name: CORRIDOR_STEP_CATCH
keys.support_contact: rear lands wide and reclaims load; front remains brace
keys.motion_arc_root_note: new rear support lands farther back and root follows into widened base
keys.tool_arc_note: tool orientation remains substantially deflected; no cheap rotational reset
keys.clearance_note: new negative space now exists behind/below hook

keys.name: AXIAL_WITHDRAW_AFTER_CLEARANCE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root stabilizes over purchased rear support
keys.tool_arc_note: tool retracts along deflected shaft axis without rotating first
keys.clearance_note: hook head clears synthetic deflector/body envelope along proven axis

keys.name: ROTATE_ONLY_AFTER_CLEAR
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root continues small rearward settle while rotation resumes
keys.tool_arc_note: only after axial clearance does shaft rotate downward toward a carry line
keys.clearance_note: rotation spends newly purchased corridor, not blocked outgoing corridor

keys.name: REGRIP_OVERSHOOT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis overshoots rearward beyond eventual recovery stack
keys.tool_arc_note: rear hand drags butt farther back while front hand lags high; hook drops past carry line
keys.clearance_note: tool and torso do not arrive together, exposing displaced recovery debt

keys.name: SECONDARY_HAND_LAG_CATCH
keys.support_contact: dual support restored; rear still primary
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root moves forward a little from recoil overshoot while feet stay widened
keys.tool_arc_note: front hand and tool head rebound later than pelvis; shaft rises out of overshoot
keys.clearance_note: secondary hand/tool lag pays after root brake rather than mirroring attack

keys.name: DISPLACED_READY
keys.support_contact: dual support in wider rear-shifted base
keys.motion_arc_root_note: body settles behind and wider than contact stance, not back to K00
keys.tool_arc_note: tool returns to usable forward line but butt remains tucked inside new corridor
keys.clearance_note: recovery ends with purchased space still visible in stance geometry

compile.renderer: abstract ASCII rig only; ffmpeg libx264 preset=veryslow crf=42 yuv420p

quality_thesis: Deflection rotates the return corridor. The body must purchase rear clearance before axial withdrawal, then rotate only after clear, then pay recoil/lag into a displaced ready.

correction_history.correction: suppress interpolation whenever either foot support state or contact group changes

observations: deflection visibly rotates the hooked shaft into a different return corridor
root continues into the front brace while contact owns the shaft rotation
rear support leaves and catches wider before withdrawal begins
withdrawal follows the changed shaft axis before late rotation
recoil overshoots behind the eventual stack; hand/tool lag resolves after the root brake
recovery remains visibly wider and rear-shifted instead of resetting to K00
state-safe connector policy does not pre-announce support or contact state changes
